title: Gewerbsmäßiger Computerbetrug und Diebstahl – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?

extraction.summaryEn: Police are searching for a suspect who allegedly stole mailed bank cards and PINs and withdrew money between August 2024 and September 2024, with three theft and nine computer fraud cases attributed. Surveillance images of the suspect at an ATM on Leipziger Platz were released.
